text.en: Welcome to the sanctuary. Looking for a spell, or just somewhere quiet to catch your breath?
text.zh-CN: 欢迎来到圣所。想找一道法术，还是找个清静地方歇歇？

text.en: Musashi. Two swords, and not enough breath for either?
text.zh-CN: 武藏，带着两把剑，气却连挥一把都不够？

text.en: The swords are fine. It's their owner who's wheezing.
text.zh-CN: 剑都好好的。喘不上气的，是拿剑的人。

text.en: I'd offer you a potion, but I suspect you'd try to parry it.
text.zh-CN: 本想给你一瓶药，可我怕你抬手就要格挡。

text.en: Only if it came at me point-first.
text.zh-CN: 除非你把瓶口当剑尖，朝我刺过来。

text.en: Good. Your wit survived. Has a physician seen you?
text.zh-CN: 还好，嘴上功夫没丢。找医师看过了吗？

text.en: Not one who could explain it. Breathing shouldn't be the hardest part of swordplay.
text.zh-CN: 没人说得清缘由。练剑最难的，总不该是喘气吧。

text.en: Then let's ask Hippocrates at the Healer's House. I'll come along. Take my Viper's Hex Tome, too; it may prove more useful than stubbornness.
text.zh-CN: 那就去医师居所，问问希波克拉底。我和你们同行。这本蝰蛇咒术法术书也带上，兴许比硬撑管用。
